svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Manifold: 30 OD stainless tube 1040 long, ends capped.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 4 mm holes every 50 along the underside, in two rows 30

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: degrees each side of straight down (about 40 holes).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Riser: 30 OD tube 70 long welded upright into the manifold as a tee,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 150 in from the hood end nearest the trailer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top flange: 3 mm plate, 70 round, welded to the riser; the steam

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: coupling screws into the riser above it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two hanger straps 20 x 2 hold the manifold 15 below the inner skin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the riser goes up through the hood; the flange is bolted on top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: blow through it: air comes out of every hole.
